inputs_used: content-system/seo/link-map.csv (grep: photographer, cost, checklist, timeline, magazine pages)

payload.title: Average Wedding Photographer Cost and What Packages Include
protect_keywords: how much does a wedding photographer cost
what do wedding photography packages include
payload.audience: 30s, couples who are interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, 150k+ AUD budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s planning a destination or luxury wedding with a generous budget, who searched for an average photographer cost and need to understand what actually drives a quote, what a package should spell out in writing, what is commonly charged as an extra, and what their consumer and copyright position is before they sign.
payload.goal: Speak with a Wedded Advisor about planning a destination wedding (single primary CTA, placed after the destination weddings section); /magazine as a soft secondary link in the close.
payload.angle: Page-one results quote a national average that tells a destination couple almost nothing. We say plainly that there is no single honest average for a couple like ours, then show what actually shapes a photographer's quote (coverage hours, second shooter, travel and accommodation, pre-wedding shoot, albums and prints, editing and delivery timing, image licence and usage, season and day of week, experience), give a component checklist of what a package should state in writing and what is often extra, add destination-specific questions (travel, accommodation, venue or location photography rules, backup photographer), and explain deposits, cancellations, written agreements and copyright in commissioned photos as the ACCC and the Copyright Act sources state them. No figures of any kind, by the person's decision.
must_include: Intro, then exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways
Why there is no single honest average for a destination or luxury couple (framed as our view, no statistics, no research talk)

What shapes the cost, as advice not statistics: coverage hours; second shooter; travel and accommodation; pre-wedding shoot; albums and prints; editing and delivery timing; licence and usage of the images; season and day of week; experience
What packages include and what is often extra: a component checklist with no prices

Destination weddings: travel, accommodation, venue or location rules for photography framed as questions to ask, and a backup photographer; link planned N-508 destination photographer cost post with a placeholder link (URL unknown); single primary CTA to /wonderland-concierge after this section

Contracts and consumer rights: deposits, cancellations and written agreements as the ACCC states them; copyright ownership of commissioned photos under the Copyright Act 1968 as official sources state them; official sources linked inline at each claim
Questions to ask and how to compare quotes in writing (like for like checklist)

Close with one Wedded Advisor line using brand-facts.md confirmed claims only (for example one Advisor start to finish, quotes in AUD, confirms inclusions in writing before the couple commits), linking /wonderland-concierge and /magazine

Internal links: /expert-advice/what-does-an-italy-wedding-photographer-cost (prominent, in the destination section), /expert-advice/how-much-does-a-wedding-in-italy-cost, /destination-weddings/all-inclusive-wedding-cost, /expert-advice/what-is-included-in-lake-como-wedding-packages, /expert-advice/wedding-planning-checklist, /expert-advice/wedding-day-timeline (coverage hours), /wonderland-concierge, /magazine, plus N-508 placeholder
avoid: Figures of any kind: averages, ranges, percentages, amounts, hourly rates, From prices, or numeric survey results (person's decision)
Vendor names or links to vendor pages (including /vendor/* and /au/vendors-in-sydney)
Competitor wording, claims or data (no Easy Weddings or other competitor cost surveys)
Consumer law or copyright statements paraphrased without the official source (ACCC, legislation.gov.au, Attorney-General's Department or similar) linked inline at the claim; no legal advice framing
Advisor claims beyond brand-facts.md confirmed claims: no negotiating rates, discounts, commissions, standardised supplier rates, availability, or Wedded Privileges
Research talk in the copy (sources, method, what we could or couldn't find)
Title or meta title as a question, with colons or dashes, or over 60 characters
payload.content_format: Guide (fixed by person): factors, package checklist, destination questions, contracts and rights, quote comparison, FAQ
